hero.title: For companies that want to keep their shareholders and investors informed
hero.description: Sttok gives each shareholder and investor their own access, with the company's branding. They see their position, download the certificates the company makes visible, respond to the notice, appoint a proxy or vote, and receive every communication with its proof of delivery.

includes.title: What each shareholder sees in their portal

rows.situation: An investor asks for their certificate
rows.action: They download it themselves from their portal, if the company has made it visible.
Each shareholder sees the notice in their portal and responds: attend, appoint a proxy or vote.

rows.situation: A shareholder cannot attend the meeting
rows.action: They sign a proxy or vote early on each item from their portal.

rows.situation: The company informs all its shareholders
rows.action: Every communication is logged with its status and proof of delivery.

rows.situation: The company wants the portal in its own branding
rows.action: The portal carries the company's brand colour, with a white-label option.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions about the investor portal

items.a: Their position, their visible certificates, the meetings they are called to and the documents the company shares with them.

items.q: Can they see other shareholders' data?
items.a: No. Each shareholder sees only their own.

items.q: Can they vote from the portal?
items.a: Yes. They can sign a proxy, vote early and vote at the meeting.

items.q: Does the portal carry the company's branding?
items.a: Yes. It uses the company's brand colour, and there is a white-label option.

items.q: How does each shareholder log in?
items.a: With their own user account. They can also sign in with a Google or Microsoft account.

items.q: Does it work for companies in Latin America?
items.a: The platform adapts to each country's terminology: shareholder ledger, general shareholders' meeting, board of directors. Compliance with each country's regulations is assessed case by case.
